# tebibcloud_database_plans (Data Source)

The managed Postgres plans on offer, and the versions, maintenance windows and whether high availability is on. Use a plan `code` for `tebibcloud_database.plan`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebibcloud_database_plans" "all" {}

output "database_plans" {
  value = data.tebibcloud_database_plans.all.codes
}

resource "tebibcloud_database" "app" {
  name = "app"
  plan = data.tebibcloud_database_plans.all.codes[0] # the smallest plan on offer
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `codes` (List of String) Plan codes, for `tebibcloud_database.plan`.
- `default_maintenance_window` (String) The default maintenance window.
- `default_version` (Number) The default Postgres major version.
- `ha_enabled` (Boolean) Whether `mode = "ha"` can be used for new databases.
- `maintenance_windows` (List of String) Maintenance windows to choose from, e.g. `sun-02`.
- `plans` (Attributes List) The plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `versions` (List of Number) Postgres major versions on offer.

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Plan code, e.g. `b1.micro`.
- `cpu_millicores` (Number) Exact CPU: 500 is half a vCPU.
- `default_disk_gib` (Number) Disk a new database gets.
- `max_connections` (Number) Connections the database accepts.
- `max_disk_gib` (Number) Largest disk.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) Meter name, e.g. `db.b1.micro` (see `tebibcloud_prices`).
- `schedulable` (Boolean) A database of this plan can be created right now (advisory: creating decides).
- `vcpus` (Number) Whole vCPUs, rounded up.
